records.name: Falkirk Wheel
records.description: Engineering icon on the southern approach toward Stirling, often paired with itineraries between Falkirk, Larbert and Bannockburn.

records.name: Torwood Broch
records.description: Rare Iron Age broch site hidden in woodland near Tor Wood, hinting at much earlier settlement along the Falkirk-Stirling corridor.

records.name: Tor Wood
records.description: Ancient woodland of giant oaks and folklore-rich paths close to Larbert, Torwood Castle and the Bannockburn approach.

records.name: Torwood Castle
records.description: Torwood Castle is a ruined 16th-century L-plan castle near the village of Torwood, in the Falkirk Council area of central Scotland. It was designated as a Category A listed building in 1979. The Buildings at Risk Register for Scotland originally listed its level of risk as low, but raised that level to moderate in mid-2019 after seeing signs of continued neglect.

records.name: Battle of Bannockburn Visitor Centre
records.description: Modern visitor centre and battlefield landscape commemorating Robert the Bruce's 1314 victory, an easy detour from the Falkirk-to-Stirling corridor.
records.address: Glasgow Road, Whins of Milton, Stirling FK7 0LJ

records.name: Carron Works Heritage
records.description: Legacy of the celebrated Carron Company ironworks, famed for cannon production and the carronade, which shaped the industrial story of the Falkirk-Stirling area.

records.name: Larbert Old Church
records.description: Historic parish church site reflecting Larbert's older settlement before the town expanded as a transport and healthcare hub.

records.name: Shieldhill Castle
records.description: Country-house style castle accommodation near Falkirk and Stirling, useful as a heritage stop on rural drives around the district.

records.name: Denny Heritage Trail
records.description: A walk through old Denny linking the town's industrial, canal and railway-era story in the western part of Falkirk council area.

records.name: Plean Country Park
records.description: Wooded former estate park with trails, open glades and easy family walking routes south of Stirling.

records.name: Carron Valley Reservoir
records.description: Large upland reservoir west of Denny popular for scenic drives, angling and broad views into the Campsie fringe.

records.name: Carron Valley Forest
records.description: Expansive conifer forest around the reservoir with walking, cycling and wildlife-watching opportunities.

records.name: Carron Valley Mountain Bike Trails
records.description: Outdoor trail network through forest and moorland, well known for active exploration in the western Falkirk corridor.

records.name: Dunipace Heritage Trail
records.description: Local heritage route through the old village of Dunipace, linking parish, river and industrial-era stories.

records.name: Dunipace Old Parish Church
records.description: Historic parish church site reflecting the oldest surviving community focus in the Dunipace area.

records.name: Denny Old Bridge
records.description: Traditional bridge crossing that evokes Denny's older transport links and settlement pattern.

records.name: Denny Town Centre Heritage
records.description: Historic heart of Denny where main-street buildings recall the town's industrial and market-town past.

records.name: Bonnybridge Village Heritage
records.description: Village heritage stop tied to canal transport, ironworking and the Antonine Wall landscape.

records.name: Bonny Water Walk
records.description: Waterside stroll following the Bonny Water through the western edge of Falkirk's historic industrial landscape.

records.name: River Carron Valley Walk
records.description: Riverside route connecting old settlement, woodland and open-country views between Denny and Larbert.

records.name: Cowie Village
records.description: Small village east of Stirling that works as a useful heritage stop when travelling the Falkirk-Stirling corridor.

records.name: Cowie Heritage Walk
records.description: Short heritage walk through Cowie with views to the Ochils and reminders of old mining and village life.

records.name: Bannockburn Battlefield
records.description: Historic battlefield landscape associated with Robert the Bruce's 1314 victory on the southern approach to Stirling.

records.name: Bannockburn Heritage Route
records.description: Interpretive route around Bannockburn that helps connect the visitor centre with the wider battlefield terrain.

records.name: Sauchie Tower
records.description: Striking late-medieval tower house near Stirling, one of the most atmospheric castles in the wider district.

records.name: Alloa Tower
records.description: Scotland's largest surviving keep, included here as a strong day-trip connection from the Falkirk-Stirling borderland.

records.name: Clackmannan Tower
records.description: Prominent tower-house in Clackmannan, adding depth to heritage touring north of Falkirk.

records.name: Airthrey Castle
records.description: Picturesque baronial house on the University of Stirling campus, framed by water and the Ochil Hills.

records.name: Wallace Monument Viewpoint
records.description: Viewpoint toward Stirling's iconic monument, often glimpsed on clear days from the Falkirk side of the corridor.

records.name: Cambusbarron Village
records.description: Village south-west of Stirling with a distinct traditional character and links to nearby Touch and Gillies Hill country.

records.name: Touch Estate
records.description: Historic estate landscape on the edge of the Carse, blending country-house heritage with rural viewpoints.

records.name: Gargunnock Hills Viewpoint
records.description: Elevated rural viewpoint toward the Gargunnock Hills, adding sweeping west Stirlingshire scenery to the route.

records.name: Larbert House Estate
records.description: Historic estate landscape remembered for its country-house past and continuing role in Larbert's local identity.

records.name: Airth Village Heritage
records.description: Old village core with castle-country surroundings and strong connections to the upper Forth landscape.

records.name: St Ninians Old Kirk
records.description: Historic parish focus in the old burgh of St Ninians, useful for exploring Stirling's southern fringe from Falkirk.

records.name: Plean House
records.description: Former mansion house near Plean Country Park, adding another aristocratic layer to the local landscape.

records.name: Carron Bridge Heritage
records.description: Bridge heritage stop where roads, river and industry meet in the Carron and Denny area.

records.name: Tor Wood Meadow
records.description: Open glades and woodland-edge spaces near Tor Wood that complement visits to the castle and broch sites.

records.name: Carron Valley Lookout
records.description: Scenic lookout over water, forest and hills in one of the west Falkirk area's most open landscapes.

records.name: Shieldhill Estate Walk
records.description: Country-lane and estate-edge walk near Shieldhill, pairing rural views with the castle setting.
